display_long_description:
Fare & Square is a cooperative multiplayer VR trivia experience where the journey matters just as much as the destination. Players gather in a vibrant city lobby, form a group, and hop into a shared taxi for a fast-paced trivia ride. Together, they'll tackle questions from a variety of categories while chatting, laughing, and celebrating each correct answer.
The group shares three strikes. Every incorrect answer brings the team one step closer to the end of the ride. If the group reaches three strikes, the taxi pulls over and everyone is dropped back into the lobby together. Success depends on teamwork, communication, and quick thinking—not just individual knowledge.
Complete rides to earn stars, unlock cosmetic rewards, customize your taxi, and climb the leaderboards with your friends. With short, replayable sessions, rotating trivia categories, and a social-first design, Fare & Square delivers an exciting party experience where every ride is a new chance to prove your team has what it takes to make it to the finish.
